briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI escalate multi-agent model race amid safety concerns

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies with new frontier releases from major labs while regulatory scrutiny grows. Compute scaling continues at unprecedented pace across US and China.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4-preview with advanced agentic capabilities. xAI's Grok-4 demonstrates superior reasoning benchmarks. DeepSeek-V3 closes gap on Western models.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level through adaptive multi-agent dialects.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA announces Blackwell Ultra ramp with TSMC. Microsoft and Google expand dedicated AI data center clusters in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent protocol-level defenses like dynamic dialects become mandatory for all frontier deployments by 2027?
